WSH.head: Close, but Pittsburgh has the slight edge
WSH.body: Pittsburgh has had more of the chances over recent games and Washington has home ice. Washington’s best way to tip it is getting to the dangerous areas.

PIT.head: Pittsburgh starts a half-step ahead
PIT.body: Pittsburgh has had more of the chances over recent games and Washington has home ice. Washington can still swing it if it gets to the dangerous areas.
